posts.summary:
The Department of the Navy awarded a task order to Saronic Technologies, Inc. under the GSA Multiple Award Schedule contract vehicle for unmanned surface vehicle operations support. The task order, signed on July 1, 2026, carries an obligation of approximately $29 million and runs through February 11, 2027. The work involves professional intelligence support services related to Corsair unmanned surface vehicle operations conducted by the contractor.

The task order was awarded through full and open competition and was recently released to the public in November 2026. Saronic Technologies will provide contractor-owned and contractor-operated capabilities in support of Navy operations.

posts.summary:
The General Services Administration's Federal Acquisition Service awarded ClearAvenue LLC a blanket purchase agreement call valued at approximately $13.3 million. The award was signed on July 24, 2026, and became public on November 17, 2026. ClearAvenue will provide computer-related services in the information technology and telecommunications sector, specifically supporting security and compliance efforts.

The work runs from August 27, 2026, through August 26, 2027, under the DEHRADS cybersecurity, privacy, records management, and environments support program. The award was made through full and open competition and falls under the other computer-related services classification.

posts.summary:
The Department of Health and Human Services, Office of the Assistant Secretary for Financial Resources, awarded Dell Federal Systems L.P. a blanket purchase agreement call order valued at approximately $11.4 million for software licensing and support services. The award was signed on June 22, 2026, and became public in November 2026. The call order operates under the GSA Multiple Award Schedule contract vehicle and follows full and open competition procedures.

The work involves providing Microsoft E5 premium licenses and unified support services to HHS. Performance runs from June 30, 2026, through September 15, 2027. This procurement falls under the software publishing industry classification and addresses business application and software-as-a-service needs for information technology and telecommunications.
